data.long_meaning: The name Gensmer is derived from the Old German words ‘gis’ meaning ‘pledge, hostage, or guarantee’ and ‘meri’ meaning ‘famous, renowned, or warrior’. This name was given to a child born into a family with a strong military heritage. The name Gensmer carries the meaning “Germanic: Spear Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gensmer usually hope their child will grow to embody germanic: spear warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
